scope: Recovery Stage 2 independent static implementation review

findings.conclusion: No concrete implementation defect found in the released fixture.

reviewCoverage.reason: The request mutator selects the inject request. The response mutator checks its request, full control, plan/resource/startup and completed running status. close() synchronously terminates both sockets before forwardToCore can send or queue the returned frame. Unrelated responses re-arm the cleared mutator slot.

reviewCoverage.contract: Canonical unknown outcome before process interruption
reviewCoverage.reason: The public call must settle outcome-unknown and run.status must retain outcome_unknown. The Core owner settles before returning; its startup recovery skips terminal unknown Runs. Later original-resource observation does not rewrite the original Run.

reviewCoverage.contract: Exact process ownership and persisted-authentication reopen
reviewCoverage.reason: The resident is verified as the captured Shell child with the exact copied runtime and installed fixed argv. Kill/wait uses owned Proc objects and helper creation identity. Reopen uses original disk state and Node token, the new Core URL and a new operator, with no Node re-pairing, permission reset or second deploymentFixture call.
PID, /proc start ticks and startup marker are compared across termination/reopen. Original plan, resource identities, attempts and steps stay unchanged; an observer revision increase is allowed.

reviewCoverage.contract: One restart and explicit fresh-startup authority
reviewCoverage.reason: Only the verified original CID is restarted, once, with a 35-second stop allowance and 45-second outer bound. The new Native startup must be unbound/waiting with no child, preserved volume marker and absent tmpfs marker. Only explicit resume creates the fresh startup Run/Attempt/Effect/request/checkpoint/authorization and C1 mapping. Repeated start/resume only observe.

reviewCoverage.contract: Effect evidence, containment and owned cleanup
reviewCoverage.reason: Pre-restart exec metadata is retained before IDs can retire. Resource events and actual no-TTY exec metadata establish one volume/container create, two starts and two submitters; read probes are not grant counts. Bounded scans and finally cleanup use original engine/registry/resource/image/path/token bindings, preserve unknown failures, and do not claim shared daemon or cache cleanup.

The fixture claims outer Host completion loss and filesystem markers only. Inner Native ACK and create/start/submit faults, custody rotation, daemon restart, database correctness, C1 service, C2b and real data/model/manual acceptance remain separate. deploymentReady stays false. No production/template/spec contract changed, so no .trellis/spec update is required.

results.name: single-entry-no-emit
results.command: & 'C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe' --input-type=module -e 'import ts from "typescript"; import fs from "node:fs"; const file=".trellis/tasks/10-14-hindsight-managed-deployment/research/docker-recovery/run-recovery.ts"; const base=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("tsconfig.base.json","utf8")); const parsed=ts.convertCompilerOptionsFromJson(base.compilerOptions,process.cwd()); const program=ts.createProgram([file],{...parsed.options,noEmit:true,incremental:false}); const errors=[...parsed.errors,...ts.getPreEmitDiagnostics(program)]; console.log(JSON.stringify({entry:file,noEmit:true,diagnostics:errors.map(d=>({file:d.file?.fileName,line:d.file&&d.start!==undefined?d.file.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(d.start).line+1:undefined,code:d.code,message:ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(d.messageText,"\n")}))})); process.exitCode=errors.length?1:0;'
